text: and use that data to finalize the definition. This graphic illustrates two primary problems context solves. First, different meanings. Light means brightness for a lamp, but not heavy for a suitcase. Second, pronouns. If the cat drank the milk because it was thirsty, it is the cat. If it was fresh, it's the milk.
Making all words available at once solves the distance problem.
The attention mechanism focuses on terms like turn on and carry to resolve light. It isolates thirsty and fresh to determine exactly what IT refers to.

But processing every word at once introduces a severe mathematical problem that the old sequential method never had. When the entire message arrives together, the AI loses all inherent sense of word order.
